user.title: Add a Logix device
user.description: Enter the address of your Logix device. Devices on the same network are usually found automatically.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname, for example 192.168.1.50 or esp12f-e527.local.

credentials.title: Admin password
credentials.description: {name} is protected by an admin password. Enter the password set under Device Settings → Hostname & Security.

reauth_confirm.title: Admin password changed
reauth_confirm.description: The admin password for {name} no longer works. Enter the current one.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the same device.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device. Check the address and that it is on the network.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this device is already in progress.
abort.api_too_new: This device's firmware is newer than this integration supports. Update the LogixDIY integration.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The discovered device sent incomplete information.
abort.not_supported: This Logix model is not supported yet. Update the LogixDIY integration.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different Logix device.

data_description.use_mqtt: If the device and Home Assistant use the same MQTT broker, state changes and button actions are pushed instantly and polling slows to once a minute.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the device when MQTT push is not available. Button actions are detected on each poll, so shorter is more responsive.

api_too_new.message: The device firmware is newer than this integration supports.

invalid_auth.message: The device rejected the admin password.

no_colors.message: Give at least one color to set.

not_supported.message: This Logix model is not supported by this version of the integration.

wrong_device.message: The device at {host} is a different Logix device. Update its address under Reconfigure.

set_led_colors.name: Set LED colors
set_led_colors.description: Changes the saved colors of a Logix LED without changing which color it is showing. Give only the colors you want to change.

hold_color.name: Hold color
hold_color.description: Shown after holding the button for 3 seconds.

off_color.name: Off color
off_color.description: Shown while the LED is off. Black means dark.
